gloss: to restrict; to limit; to cap

definitions.gloss: to restrict, to limit, to set a cap on
definitions.explanation: To set an upper boundary or cap on quantity, time, access, or other measurable things. Implies a defined maximum or allowable range.

examples.japanese: {速度|そくど}を{制限|せいげん}する。
{一日|いちにち}のカロリー{摂取|せっしゅ}を{制限|せいげん}する。
このアプリは{子供|こども}の{使用|しよう}{時間|じかん}を{制限|せいげん}する{機能|きのう}がある。
examples.english: This app has a function to limit children's usage time.

notes:
Emphasizes setting a numerical or measurable cap. The noun form {制限|せいげん} is very common in everyday life.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {速度|そくど}{制限|せいげん}: speed limit
- {年齢|ねんれい}{制限|せいげん}: age restriction
- {時間|じかん}{制限|せいげん}: time limit
- {制限|せいげん}{速度|そくど}: restricted speed
- {食事|しょくじ}{制限|せいげん}: dietary restriction
- {制限|せいげん}なく: without restriction

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {限定|げんてい}する: to limit — narrows scope or target group (members only, limited edition)
- {制限|せいげん}する: to restrict — sets a numerical cap or upper bound (speed limit, time limit)
- {規制|きせい}する: to regulate — imposes official rules and controls
